name_en: The guard that fire cannot hurt
trap: A fire mage (immune to fire, 80 HP) stands on a platform between the player and a wand; a Fireball spell lies at the door as the obvious weapon and does nothing to it; a trough of oil lies in front of its platform (its own fireballs light it) and a bottle of water lies at the door
cue: inspect or the entity list shows the mage's fire resistance in how fireballs behave; the oil trough is drawn; water wets the mage and hurts it
notes: Water thrown at the mage hurts it (45 HP/s while wet); the Fireball spell is the wrong tool; the oil burns away once the mage has shot into it.

lessons.note: The guard is a fire mage: fireballs do nothing to it
The guard is hurt by water: throw water on it
